scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 workable with substantial friction; 7 good with noticeable friction; 10 exceptional. Subjective observed mobile-emulation quality, not a win/loss grade or physical-device certification. Overall is holistic, not an arithmetic average.

reasons.overall_mobile: Useful touch assistance and strong atmosphere made objective progress possible, but portrait combat/target visibility and threat management caused substantial friction.
reasons.controls: Large route/fire controls and tap aim support two-thumb play; TURN is useful. Fine aiming, timing and repositioning were not reliably mastered. No physical thumb ergonomics assessed.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery-to-coil sequence and armor windows provide visible structure. Combat pressure and ammo consumption complicated engaging that structure. Upload and later content unassessed.
reasons.presentation: Cohesive cyan/amber visual language, atmospheric architecture, distinct title and clear terminal layout in observed screens. Audio unassessed.
reasons.usability: Handbook, map pause, route assist, explicit ammo fallback prompt and separate fresh/checkpoint choices are helpful. Dense control set and RELEASE USE wording add friction.
reasons.readability: Major objectives and health/ammo readable; dark scenery, narrow view, small coil targets and tiny secondary text require careful paused inspection.
